jobs.name: 01_film_cel
jobs.title: 梦境放映 · 复古动漫赛璐璐
jobs.prompt: Create ONE polished game art-direction concept image showing actual FIRST PERSON GAMEPLAY, landscape 16:9. This is a playable-looking 3D arena survival roguelite screen, not a poster, character sheet, third-person view or isometric view. Eye level 1.65m, moderately wide field of view, horizon near mid-height, readable foreground/midground/background. A spacious courtyard-like performance hall with a central stage, side passages, two balcony levels, waist-high cover and clear navigable ground. Three distinct hostile figures at 8-20 meters, one enemy reacting to an attack. Keep the central aiming area unobstructed. Player hands and a tangible themed tool occupy only the lower 20 percent of the screen. No firearms, no tactical military equipment, no science-fiction gun, no giant floating capsule. Restrained combat VFX with clear trajectory and impact, no full-screen bloom. Include a coherent understated readable game HUD: upper-left active tool icon followed by exactly eight small physical sequence slots (four occupied, four empty) and a highlighted playback cursor; smaller spare tool icon beneath it; small circular north-up minimap underneath with centered player arrow and a few enemy dots; top-center countdown 08:42; tiny centered reticle with a curved charge/ammo gauge immediately to its right; bottom-left character portrait, red health bar and thin experience bar; three small empty utility slots bottom-right; small pause icon top-right. HUD design must belong to this art direction, total HUD footprint less than 15 percent. Minimal numeric text only, no large titles, no watermark. Background contrast below enemies and attack silhouettes. Aim for an appealing coherent shippable game screenshot concept rather than generic cinematic concept art. THEME: dream projection. Player wears simple projectionist gloves and holds a compact antique hand-cranked film projector with two recognizable reels, a glass lens and tactile mechanical crank in the lower right, with the other hand steadying it. Projecting a translucent running paper wolf through a suspended luminous rectangular film frame toward a hostile cutout performer; a second smaller exposed film frame conveys duplication. This projection attack is visibly connected to the held projector. Enemies are unfinished animated characters with expressive simplified silhouettes, mismatched frame outlines and stage-prop anatomy. Setting is an impossible old cinema opening into a dream courtyard: distant projection screen, theatre curtains, film strips used as architectural trim, open walkways. Sequence slots resemble distinct film frames, not musical notes. VISUAL STYLE: retro hand-painted Japanese animation interpreted as a modern 3D cel-shaded first-person game. Crisp ink contours, simple expressive shapes, decisive two-tone hard shadows, matte painted background color blocks, restrained texture. Cool indigo and dusty teal environment, warm apricot light, bright cyan and coral attacks. Stylized human-scale proportions, strong animation keyframe poses. Not photorealistic, not pixel art, not a miniature diorama. Hand-drawn graphic HUD with fine clean lines.
